LanguageData.ABY_AbyssalGravplatePrototype.label: dominion gravplate shell
LanguageData.ABY_AbyssalGravplatePrototype.descriptio: A dominion survival frame that turns crown pressure into battlefield motion. The shell does not simply protect the wearer; it suspends their mass on a hostile vector lattice, sheds incoming fire through a fast internal aegis, and lets breach-line fighters cross kill zones before the ground can fully claim them.
LanguageData.ABY_AbyssalGravplateHelmPrototype.label: dominion gravplate helm
LanguageData.ABY_AbyssalGravplateHelmPrototype.descri: A sealed command helm for the dominion gravplate line. Its horned faceplate and violet crown lenses translate hostile terrain, incoming fire and unstable breach vectors into a usable combat picture, letting the wearer aim while the shell beneath them refuses ordinary gravity.
